standard_prerequisites: the definition of rig-etale morphisms of locally Noetherian formal algebraic spaces via etale covers and rig-etale arrows of WAdm^Noeth (definition-rig-etale)
rig-etale-ness is a local property of arrows of WAdm^Noeth (lemma-rig-etale-axioms of the same chapter)

the Formal Spaces lemma that a local property of arrows defines a property of morphisms (formal-spaces-lemma-property-defines-property-morphisms) in its Noetherian variant (formal-spaces-remark-variant-Noetherian)
core_obligations: Prove the equivalence of: (1) f is rig-etale; (2) every commutative diagram with U and V affine formal algebraic spaces and U to X, V to Y etale and representable gives a rig-etale arrow U to V in WAdm^Noeth; (3) some cover of Y as in the formal algebraic spaces definition together with covers of the base changes gives rig-etale arrows; (4) some cover of X factors through etale maps toward affine Y_i over Y with rig-etale arrows X_i to Y_i
proof_roadmap: The equivalence of (1) and (2) is exactly the definition of rig-etale.

The equivalences among (2), (3) and (4) follow from rig-etale-ness being a local property of arrows of WAdm^Noeth together with the property-defines-property-morphisms template in its Noetherian variant.
difficulty_reason: H2: a characterization template proof that instantiates the local-property-of-arrows lemma for rig-etale-ness.
